extractedText: Home Entertainment TV&Showbiz Kim YuNa, the ”figure queen,” shows off her adorable flirting... ”Love me” Comment Kim YuNa, the ”figure queen,” shows off her adorable flirting... ”Love me” View Gallery (+2) Former South Korean figure skater Kim YuNa recently shared, "I'm the only one who gets excited taking photos with dogs and cats. Love me." In the released photos, Kim YuNa is wearing a white down jacket. She's seen enjoying happy times with her dog while dressed in her favorite clothes, and then later, in loungewear, she's seen smiling brightly as she waves a toy in front of her cat. Kim YuNa's unpretentious yet pure beauty, in particular, is drawing admiration. Meanwhile, Kim YuNa is a leading figure skater from South Korea, having achieved outstanding results in numerous international competitions, including an Olympic gold medal. She was the first Olympic gold medalist in figure skating history and earned the nickname "Queen Yuna" for her perfect performance and technical skills. She officially retired from competitive sports after the 2014 Sochi Olympics. Since being appointed a UNICEF International Goodwill Ambassador in 2010, she has been involved in the Haiti earthquake. Activities to protect children both domestically and internationally, including support for families of boys and girls in South Korea, and assistance for the Daegu region affected by the COVID-19 virus, in response to the Syrian civil war, Typhoon Haiyan in the Philippines, the Nepal earthquake, and more. She dedicated herself to this. Also, in October 2022, she married Ko WooRim, a member of the group "Forestella," and they became husband and wife. Ko WooRim enlisted in the army as an active-duty soldier on November 20, 2023.
